registration.interpretation: This is a causal diagnostic, not a replacement performance gate or a claim of startup speedup. Report every phase and every sample, including negative values. Even matching code and current I/O-wait evidence cannot prove the OS cause of a historical single long sample. An independent review must explicitly retain that causal limit and the original +14.0423% startup mean before deciding whether the bounded cost is acceptable. No automatic override of the original accepted=false.

plan.evidence: Verify the pinned complete runtime hashes before and after the run. Independently compare unchanged constructor, context-enter, validation, schema definitions and every other store method except the registered recall change. Preserve every start, finish, worker and failure record. Never overwrite or retry a started trial.
plan.input: Fresh empty database in a fresh directory on the same filesystem for every subprocess. No corpus is ingested and recall is never invoked. No result cache, model, network, or generated answer.
plan.measurements: Separate plain and instrumented phases. Both record constructor-plus-context-enter wall time and process CPU. The instrumented phase adds SQLite connect/execute/executescript timings and timestamped SQL trace. Instrumentation overhead is included only in that phase and is never combined with plain or original timings.
